title: leucorchis albida
intro: Leucorchis albida, commonly known as the white form orchid or white helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Leucorchis albida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, and are used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential uses.
